data.gender_notes: Musfir is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Musfir means 'visitor' or 'traveler' in Arabic and Islamic tradition. The name Musfir carries the meaning “Visitor, Traveler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Musfir usually hope their child will grow to embody visitor, traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
